simple.meaning: גָּבַהּ (gâbahh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to soar , i.e. be lofty ; figuratively, to be haughty.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 34 times in 1 Samuel, 2 Chronicles, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, and 5 more, beginning at 1 Samuel 10:23. The surrounding contexts include birth, altar, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּבַהּ (H1361) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: גָּבַהּ (gâbahh) / H1361 is traced through 1 Samuel 10:23, 2 Chronicles 17:6, 2 Chronicles 26:16, 2 Chronicles 32:25 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to soar , i.e. be lofty ; figuratively, to be haughty
definitions.usage: exalt, be haughty, be (make) high(-er), lift up, mount up, be proud, raise up great height, upward.
definitions.full: H1361. gabahh גָּבַהּ verb be high, exalted (Late Hebrew id. (Hiph`il), Aramaic גְּבַהּ , compare Arabic forehead , prominence of forehead ; compare perhaps also Assyrian gabâni , heights (?) Lotz TP 133 ) — Qal Perfect ׳ג 2Chr 26:16 5 t.; גָָּֽבְהָא֯ Ezek 31:5 ( א = ה ); גָּבַהְתָּ 31:10 , גָּבְהוּ Job 35:5 3 t.; Imperfect יִגְבַּהּ Prov 18:12 5 t.; suffix יִגְבְּהוּ Ezek 31:14 , יִגְבָּ֑הוּ Job 36:7 , תִּגְבָּ֑הוּ Jer 13:15 , תִּגְבְּהֶינָה Ezek 16:50 ; Infinitive כִּגְבֹהַּ Psa 103:11 , לְגָבְהָה Zeph 3:11 ; — 1 be high, lofty, tall , e.g. tree Ezek 19:11 ; 31:5 , 10 , 14 , heavens Job 35:5 ; Isa 55:9 ; Psa 103:11 , man 1Sam 10:23 . 2 be exalted , of man in dignity and honour Job 36:7 , of servant of Yahweh Isa 52:13 , God 5:16 , God's ways 55:9 . 3 lofty לִבּוֺ גָּבַהּ : — a. in a good sense , encouraged in the ways of Yahweh 2Chr 17:6 ; b. elsewhere in a bad sense , be haughty Psa 131:1 ; Prov 18:12 ; 2Chr 26:16 ; 32:25 ; Ezek 28:2 , 5 , 17 , and so without לב Isa 3:16 ; Jer 13:15 ; Ezek 16:50 ; Zeph 3:11 . Hiph`il Perfect הִגְבַּהְתִּי Ezek 17:24 ; Imperfect יַגְבִּיהַּ Job 39:27 ; Jer 49:16 ; Obadiah 4; וַיַּגְבִּיהֶהָ 2Chr 33:14 ; יַגְבִּיהוּ Job 5:7 ; Infinitive הַגְבֵּהַּ Isa 7:11 ; Ezek 21:31 ; Participle מַגְבִּיהַּ Prov 17:19 ; Psa 113:5 ; — make high, exalt , e.g. trees Ezek 17:24 , wall 2Chr 33:14 , gate Prov 17:19 , nest Jer 49:16 ; Obadiah 4, dwelling Psa 103:5 , a request Isa 7:11 , the lowly Ezek 21:31 ; עוּף יַגְבִּיהוּ make their flight high, soar aloft Job 5:7 , without עוף 39:27 .

occurrences.englishText: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
His heart was lifted up in the ways of Yahweh. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.
But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly, and he trespassed against Yahweh his God; for he went into Yahweh’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.
But Hezekiah didn’t reciprocate appropriate to the benefit done for him, because his heart was lifted up. Therefore there was wrath on him, and on Judah and Jerusalem.

Now after this, he built an outer wall to David’s city, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate. He encircled Ophel with it, and raised it up to a very great height; and he put valiant captains in all the fortified cities of Judah.
but man is born to trouble,
Look to the skies, and see.
He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous,
Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up,
For as the heavens are high above the earth,
Who is like Yahweh, our God,
Yahweh, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty;
He who loves disobedience loves strife.
Before destruction the heart of man is proud,
Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant,
but Yahweh of Armies is exalted in justice,
“Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”
Behold, my servant will deal wisely.
“For as the heavens are higher than the earth,
“For as the heavens are higher than the earth,
Hear, and give ear.
As for your terror,
They were arrogant, and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.
All the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish.
It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled.
I will pour out my indignation on you.
“Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord Yahweh says:
by your great wisdom
Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty.
Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field;
“Therefore thus said the Lord Yahweh: ‘Because you are exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’
Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.

In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings, in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.
